results.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is borderline unusable
results.content:
Every one of our devs and engineers is shocked by how good it is. One of the was low on codex tokens for the week so they went all in flash last two days. (We use it thru vertex). Didn’t miss a beat. Had Sol 5.6 and Claude opus review. Surprisingly flash 3.7 code came back cleaner than when sol and opus reviewed each other.

It makes low key think that they train their models to identify and nitpick code written by the other, and haven’t trained on Gemini yet lol.

I don’t know what you’re using it for and it’s definitely not perfect but if every benchmark on the planet says it’s a great model and you’re not seeing that. Maybe you’re doing something wrong. If you haven’t already, recommend installing the superpowers plugin, like every other harness has. That helps tremendously. [...] [](

I’m curious why anyone would want to add reviewing and verifying steps for various agents rather than you be with the AI at each step and verify each step yourself. It seems like you’re trying to build a workflow where you don’t have to do any review and verification, which all AI companies say not to do because they make mistakes and need human review. I guess it depends on how much experience you have with programming, but I still wouldn’t recommend such distance from the running agent even for beginners. The longer you let it run without you, the further away from your requirements and preferences it’ll get.
